title: Helwit Violet Nicotine Pouches 7mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Violet Nicotine Pouches introduce a unique floral flavour with soft, aromatic sweetness. This distinctive profile offers a gentle alternative to mint or fruit blends, with a smooth character that feels refined and easy-going from start to finish. Each slim pouch contains 7mg of nicotine and is crafted from plant-based materials for a comfortable, low-profile fit under the lip. The pouches release nicotine gradually with no smoke, vapour or odour, making them ideal for discreet use in any setting. Made in Sweden using a climate-compensated process, Helwit pouches deliver a clean, mess-free format for those who appreciate something a little different in both flavour and function. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
